segments.he: מַתְנִי׳ הָאוֹכֵל אֵצֶל חָמִיו בִּיהוּדָה שֶׁלֹּא בְּעֵדִים — אֵינוֹ יָכוֹל לִטְעוֹן טַעֲנַת בְּתוּלִים, מִפְּנֵי שֶׁמִּתְיַיחֵד עִמָּהּ.
segments.en: «MISHNA:» A man «who eats at» the house of «his father-in-law in Judea» after betrothal and «without witnesses» to attest to the fact that he was not alone with his betrothed «is unable to make a claim concerning virginity» after marriage «because» in accordance with the custom in Judea, the assumption is «that he secluded himself with her,» and the concern is that it was he who engaged in intercourse with her.

moves.cueHe: האוכל אצל חמיו ביהודה שלא בעדים
moves.summary: Judean groom secluded before marriage loses the virginity claim

positions.claim: one who eats at his father-in-law's in Judea without witnesses cannot make a virginity claim
positions.basis: he is presumed to have been secluded with her
